arguments.name: $direction
accepts: none, both, horizontal, vertical, block, inline or auto, in any case
a CSS-wide keyword, var(), or null to leave resize out; a quoted keyword is written without its quotes

arguments.name: $overflow
accepts: one or two of visible, hidden, clip, scroll, auto and overlay, such as hidden auto
a CSS-wide keyword on its own, var(), or null to leave overflow out; a quoted value is written without its quotes
